settings.title: Settings
settings.audienceHelp: Shapes how the coach explains things
settings.chessComHelp: Used to import games for review
settings.ttsPreviewText: Hello, I am your chess coach.
settings.adminHint: You're an admin — use the Admin section in the sidebar to manage users and system-wide settings (Ollama, Stockfish).
settings.kidEmotionsDesc: Help kids read the whole board at a glance — pieces show feelings based on what's happening.
settings.kidEmotionsEnableHelp: Little emoji bubbles float over your pieces while you play, so you can see who's a hero, who's scared, who's defending, and who's still asleep.

mood.heroDesc: Can capture a big piece, give check, or checkmate.
mood.stressedDesc: Being attacked — undefended or losing the trade.
mood.guardingDesc: Defending a friend who's under attack.
mood.sleepingDesc: Still on its starting square — wake it up!

settings.subtitle: Personalize how chess looks, sounds, and how the coach talks to you.
settings.profileDesc: Your display info and language for the interface.
settings.appearanceDesc: Pick a site theme and a board you'll enjoy looking at.
settings.coachDesc: How the AI Coach interacts during games and reviews.

behaviorDesc.silent: Coach won't speak or appear during games.
behaviorDesc.on_demand: Coach is silent until you ask for a hint or explanation.
behaviorDesc.always_on_pedagogical: Coach narrates the game in a teaching voice. Best for learners.

settings.soundAssistDesc: Audio feedback and learning aids during play.
settings.soundEffectsDesc: Play piece-move, capture, check, castle and game-end sounds.
settings.blunderWarningDesc: When playing, the engine quickly checks your move. If it looks like a mistake or blunder, ask before committing. Recommended for kids and beginners.
settings.ttsDesc: Coach can read its explanations aloud. Uses your operating system's voices.
settings.ttsNoVoices: No voices found for this language. Install the OS language pack to see more options.
settings.lichessHelp: Used to import games for review

moveSoundSetDesc.classic: Synthesized wood knocks — the original Patzer sounds.
moveSoundSetDesc.board: Recordings of real pieces set down on a wooden board.

soundSetDesc.classic: Bright bells — the original Patzer sounds.
soundSetDesc.soft: Warm wooden marimba notes that match the move sounds.

admin.deleteConfirm: Delete user {{name}}? This cannot be undone.
admin.system_intro: System-wide settings. These apply to everyone.
admin.invitesIntro: Share a link or a code so people can create their own account.
admin.invitePresetHint: Without a preset, new accounts get the browser's language and the Beginner level. Both can be changed later in Settings.
admin.inviteCreatedBody: Send the link — or pass on the code, which can be typed in on the sign-up page.
admin.revokeInviteConfirm: Withdraw this invite? Accounts already created with it stay.
admin.invitesClosedWarning: Account creation is set to “Nobody”, so these invites don't work right now. Change it under
admin.invitesOpenHint: Anyone can sign up right now, so nobody needs an invite — but an invite still sets the language and audience level of the new account.
admin.signupConfigIntro: Control whether visitors can create their own accounts.

signupModes.openHint: Anyone who can reach this server can sign up.
signupModes.inviteHint: Only with an invite code from Admin → Users.

admin.requireVerificationHint: New users must confirm their email before signing in.
admin.requireVerificationNeedsSmtp: Configure SMTP below to enable this.
admin.notifyAdminsHint: Email every admin when someone registers.
admin.publicBaseUrlHint: Base address used in email links (e.g. http://ardi:8800). Leave blank to use the request host.
admin.smtpConfigIntro: Outgoing mail for verification, password resets and notifications.
admin.smtpEnvOverride: SMTP is set via environment variables, which override these fields.
admin.smtpSecureHint: On for port 465; off for 587/25 (STARTTLS is automatic).
admin.smtpPassKept: Leave blank to keep the current password.
admin.sendTestEmailHint: Save first — the test uses the saved settings.
admin.llmDesc: LLM for the AI Coach — a local Ollama or OpenAI-compatible vLLM server, or the hosted DeepSeek API. Each is configured independently, so switching providers doesn't lose the other's settings.
admin.noModels: No models loaded — set the URL above and click Test, or type a model name manually.
admin.stockfishDesc: Native chess engine for analysis and bot play.

trainer.intro: Pick a line. Patzer plays the other side, you find your moves. Every move you miss comes back in your daily review.
trainer.reviewEmpty: Nothing here yet. Every move you miss lands here and comes back once a day until you've got it right on {{n}} different days.
trainer.repertoireHint: Want to drill your own openings? In the Repertoire tab, pick any position in the tree and click “Practice this line”.
trainer.notReached: You never reached this position with this color — the line is just the moves you picked.
trainer.tooShort: There's no move of yours in this line yet — pick a later position or the other color.
trainer.yourMove: Your move — how does the line go on?
trainer.wrong: That's not the move of this line. Try again.
trainer.playArrow: Play the move the arrow shows.
trainer.doneScore: You knew {{first}} of {{total}} moves straight away.
trainer.doneMissed: The moves you missed are now in your daily review.
trainer.reviewTask: Find the next move of this line.
trainer.reviewPlayIt: Play it once on the board so it sticks.
trainer.learned: Learned! This move leaves the queue.
trainer.backTomorrow: Right {{streak}} of {{n}} times — see you tomorrow.
trainer.startsOver: It comes back tomorrow and starts over.

update.checkHelp: Once every six hours, Patzer asks GitHub whether a newer release exists and shows a one-line notice if so. It sends nothing about you or your games — it is an unauthenticated read of a public page. Turn it off if this machine has no internet, or if you would rather track releases yourself.
